reference.overall_uncertainty_note: Approximately 2 kJ mol^-1, not only statistical uncertainties.

comparison_definition: Unweighted MAE against the unchanged DMC central values for exactly these three crystals. Electronic lattice energies include gas-phase monomer relaxation, without thermal or zero-point contributions.

Liang2023CrystalMP2.table: Published SI Table S2, PDF page 3
Liang2023CrystalMP2.method_locations: Author version Eq. (6) and surrounding text, CBS/TDL extrapolation Eqs. (3)-(4). Published SI sections I-IV confirm extrapolation and numerical values.
Liang2023CrystalMP2.geometry: Original X23 PBE-TS-optimized crystal and gas-phase geometries, different from the native Della Pia geometry protocol.
Liang2023CrystalMP2.energy_definition: Positive counterpoise-corrected cohesive energy includes monomer relaxation. Negate for the manuscript lattice-energy convention.
Liang2023CrystalMP2.basis_and_sampling: Frozen-core periodic MP2 with cc-pVTZ/cc-pVQZ CBS and thermodynamic-limit extrapolation.

Syty2025CrystalCC.table: Published SI Table S5, page S-9, RPA+ph multi-level column
Syty2025CrystalCC.geometry_location: Published SI Table S1, page S-3, total lattice energy block and footnote d. Reference S7 on page S-33 identifies Della Pia 2024.
Syty2025CrystalCC.geometry: Della Pia 2024 coordinates used without reoptimization. Source-level match, not an independent coordinate-by-coordinate identity check against native input files.
Syty2025CrystalCC.energy_definition: Negative total electronic lattice energy including monomer relaxation.
Syty2025CrystalCC.method: LNO-CCSD(T) monomers and short-range dimers, RPA+ph long-range dimers and trimers, periodic HF correction. Not uniform periodic CCSD(T).
Syty2025CrystalCC.basis: Monomers/dimers aug-cc-pVTZ to aug-cc-pVQZ extrapolation, trimers aug-cc-pVTZ.
